newsitem.title: USA: Simpson lonely, broke and brooding - Time.
newsitem.headline: Simpson lonely, broke and brooding - Time.

text.p: Former American football star O.J. Simpson is virtually broke, has no steady girlfriend and broods over his legal problems, TIME magazine said on Sunday.

Simpson may have made a deal with his lawsuit insurance company to pay his legal bills and give him spending money in exchange for letting the insurer off the hook if he loses the civil case against him, TIME said, quoting a "knowledgeable source."
The sports legend facing a second trial over the murder of his former wife could then simply declare bankruptcy.

The civil trial against him was brought by the families of Nicole Brown Simpson and Ronald Goldman who were murdered on June 12, 1994. The families are suing Simpson for wrongful death and are seeking substantial financial damages.
A criminal court jury found Simpson not guilty of the killings in October 1995.

To save moneym Robert Blasier, one of Simpson's lawyers, was living in the guest house once occupied by Kato Kaelin, while Simpson's mother, sister and her husband were living in his already-refinanced Rockingham mansion, TIME said.

A member of Simpson's first defence team told TIME that Simpson's financial adviser, Skip Taft, looked at Simpson's possessions but found nothing significant aside from the house and his Manhattan condominium, which has since been sold.
Simpson also has bills from the custody battle with Nicole Brown Simpson's parents over the couple's two children, who have been living with the Browns since the murders.
Earlier this year, Robert Baker, Simpson's lead attorney in the civil case, threatened to quit over money but stayed on. Again, Simpson managed to get by, the magazine said.

In public, Simpson puts on a cheerful demeanor but TIME reported that his friends say he has gained weight, got no offers of employment and has been largely isolated, brooding at home over his troubles. The Riviera Country Club where he used to play golf has told him he was not welcome there.

A former Simpson lawyer told the magazine that Simpson occasionally dates Gretchen Stockdale, the former cheerleader and model who testified during the criminal trial that Simpson tried to telephone her the night of the murders.
Simpson never testified at his murder trial, but he did his best to make up for it on Friday in his first grueling day on the witness stand in his civil trial.
He described himself as a battered husband, accused others of lying about him and emphatically declared his innocence. Simpson will be back on the stand on Monday and Tuesday.
